bugLogs.title: Low contrast text in checkout payment hint
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Text has a contrast ratio of 1.74:1, failing the minimum requirement
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for p, change color from #c4c4c4 to #767676 (4.54:1 on #ffffff; measured 1.74:1, required 4.5:1).

_severity_override.rule: CLAUDE.md: checkout flow violations are always critical

bugLogs.title: Missing alt text on payment image button
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The image button must have a text alternative that describes its purpose
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The input[type="image"] element has no alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or associated label
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add alt="Pay now" to input[type="image"]: <input type="image" src="pay-now.png" alt="Pay now" width="120" height="40">

bugLogs.title: Missing accessible name on promo code select element
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The select element should have an accessible name announced by screen readers
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The select element has no associated label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute, making it unnamed for assistive technologies
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label and associate it with the select: <label for="promo">Promo code</label> <select id="promo" aria-label="Promo code">…</select>

bugLogs.title: Missing persistent labels for payment form fields
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each input has a visible, persistent label that remains when the field is focused
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Inputs rely solely on placeholder text; no <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attributes are present
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add <label for="pay-name">Name on card</label> before the input and <label for="pay-card">Card number</label> before the input; alternatively add aria-label="Name on card" to #pay-name and aria-label="Card number" to #pay-card

_severity_override.rule: CLAUDE.md: checkout flow violations are always critical
